text: 德国10年期国债的借贷成本势将达到至少自2010年以来的最高水平，投资者要求对持续高企的通胀和日益加剧的政治不确定性给予更高的补偿。该国财政部将于周三招标发行55亿欧元（64亿美元）将于2036年8月到期的债券。已发行在外10年期国债收益率徘徊在3.38%左右，这将是至少16年来该期限债券发行成本最高的一次。受全球抛售潮的影响，德国国债收益率在过去几周大幅上涨。（彭博）
text_en: Germany's 10-year bond borrowing costs are set to reach their highest level since at least 2010, as investors demand greater compensation for persistently elevated inflation and growing political uncertainty. The country's finance agency will auction 5.5 billion euros ($6.4 billion) of bonds maturing in August 2036 on Wednesday. The yield on outstanding 10-year bonds is hovering around 3.38%, which would mark the highest issuance cost for that maturity in at least 16 years. German bond yields have risen sharply over recent weeks amid a global selloff. (Bloomberg)
